phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Abstract interpretation analysis of validator proposer privilege assignment reveals critical state-space anomalies in the proposer lookahead initialization during fork transition. The analysis identifies potential validator set mismatches, temporal inconsistencies in RANDAO usage, and unbounded iteration risks in proposer selection.

abstract_domain.constraint: Each element must be a valid ValidatorIndex < NumValidators()

abstract_domain.slashing_constraint: May include slashed validators (no explicit filter)

variables_analyzed.temporal_dependency: Computed separately for each epoch in range [current_epoch, current_epoch + MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD]
variables_analyzed.anomaly_risk: Validator set composition may change between epoch computations

variables_analyzed.temporal_constraint: Must use pre-fork state's RANDAO for all epochs
variables_analyzed.consistency_requirement: Same state.RandaoMixes must be used for all lookahead epochs

abstract_domain.iteration_bound: Unbounded loop until valid proposer found

selection_criteria: No explicit slashing check (relies on activeIndices filter)

variables_analyzed.state_mutation_risk: Each iteration queries activeIndices from same pre-fork state

abstract_domain.lookahead_indexing: current_epoch: slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH, next_epoch: SLOTS_PER_EPOCH + (slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH)

variables_analyzed.boundary_condition: At fork boundary, lookahead[0..SLOTS_PER_EPOCH-1] = current epoch, lookahead[SLOTS_PER_EPOCH..2*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH-1] = next epoch

abstract_transformations.transformation: For each epoch e in [current, current+MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD]: activeIndices(e) -> PrecomputeProposerIndices(e) -> append to lookAhead
abstract_transformations.precondition: state must be pre-fork Electra state with valid validators
abstract_transformations.postcondition: All elements are ValidatorIndex < NumValidators() AND all are from active set

abstract_transformations.transformation: Filter validators where activation_epoch <= epoch < exit_epoch
abstract_transformations.caching: Results cached by seed = Seed(state, epoch, DOMAIN_BEACON_ATTESTER)

abstract_transformations.transformation: Unbounded loop: candidateIndex = activeIndices[shuffled(i % length)] IF weighted_random_check(effectiveBal, randomValue) THEN return candidateIndex
abstract_transformations.anomaly: Loop never explicitly checks validator.slashed; relies on activeIndices not containing slashed validators

abstract_transformations.transformation: IF slot in current_epoch: lookAhead[slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH] ELSE lookAhead[SLOTS_PER_EPOCH + (slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH)]
abstract_transformations.precondition: slot epoch must be current_epoch OR current_epoch + 1
abstract_transformations.array_access: Direct index into proposer_lookahead without bounds check (assumes lookahead.length >= 2*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH)

state_anomalies_found.description: The InitializeProposerLookahead function computes active validator indices separately for each epoch (current_epoch, current_epoch+1) using the same pre-fork state. However, validator set composition may have changed at the fork boundary (validators exiting, slashing events). The pre-fork state's validator set for epoch+1 may not match the actual post-fork validator set at that epoch.
state_anomalies_found.abstract_state: activeIndices[epoch] computed from pre-fork state for future epochs
state_anomalies_found.potential_impact: Proposer assignments for slots in epoch+1 could include validators who have exited or been slashed during the fork epoch, or exclude validators who became active
state_anomalies_found.attack_scenario: If validator V exits at slot=fork_slot, but InitializeProposerLookahead runs at fork_slot using pre-fork state, V's exit_epoch in pre-fork state is still FAR_FUTURE. Thus V appears in activeIndices for epoch+1 lookahead. V gets proposer duties for epoch+1 despite being exited.

state_anomalies_found.description: The seed used for proposer selection is derived from Seed(state, epoch, DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER), which uses state.RandaoMixes. During fork transition, InitializeProposerLookahead uses the pre-fork state for all epochs. For future epochs (current+1), the RANDAO mix in pre-fork state may differ from the actual RANDAO that will be revealed during those epochs.
state_anomalies_found.abstract_state: seed = Hash(RandaoMixes[(epoch - MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD - 1) % EPOCHS_PER_HISTORICAL_VECTOR] || DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER || epoch)
state_anomalies_found.invariant_violation: RandaoMixes[e] at pre-fork != RandaoMixes[e] at post-fork for epoch e > current
state_anomalies_found.potential_impact: Proposer assignments computed at fork time use stale RANDAO, leading to disagreement if post-fork RANDAO differs
state_anomalies_found.mitigation_note: This is likely intended behavior (use pre-fork RANDAO for determinism), but must be documented as a security assumption

state_anomalies_found.description: ActiveValidatorIndices filters validators by activation/exit epochs but does NOT explicitly exclude slashed validators. The filter is: 'activation_epoch <= epoch < exit_epoch'. A slashed validator remains in activeIndices until their exit_epoch. ComputeProposerIndex does not perform an additional slashing check.
state_anomalies_found.abstract_state: activeIndices may contain slashed validators if validator.slashed=true AND validator.exit_epoch > current_epoch
state_anomalies_found.potential_impact: Slashed validators can be assigned proposer duties via the lookahead if they are still in the active set (exit_epoch not yet reached)
state_anomalies_found.code_reference: IsActiveValidatorUsingTrie (line 50-52) only checks activation/exit, not slashed flag. ComputeProposerIndex (line 397-440) only checks effectiveBalance, not slashed.
state_anomalies_found.expected_behavior: Proposer selection should exclude slashed validators. Either activeIndices should filter them, or ComputeProposerIndex should skip them.

state_anomalies_found.description: ComputeProposerIndex contains an unbounded for loop (for i := uint64(0); ; i++) that iterates until a validator passes the weighted random check. While probabilistically bounded, there is no explicit termination condition or maximum iteration limit.
state_anomalies_found.abstract_state: Loop continues until: effectiveBal * MAX_RANDOM_VALUE >= MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE * randomValue
state_anomalies_found.worst_case: If all validators have very low effective balance, expected iterations = MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE / avg(effectiveBal)
state_anomalies_found.potential_impact: In edge cases (all validators slashed to 0 effective balance, or numeric overflow in weighted check), loop could run indefinitely or exhaust resources
state_anomalies_found.gas_cost: Each iteration performs shuffling computation (O(log N)) and state access (O(1)), cumulative cost unbounded

state_anomalies_found.type: Array Bounds Assumption in Lookahead Access
state_anomalies_found.description: beaconProposerIndexAtSlotFulu directly indexes into the proposer lookahead array without explicit bounds checking. It assumes lookahead.length >= 2*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH based on initialization, but does not verify this at runtime.
state_anomalies_found.abstract_state: Access: lookAhead[slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH] OR lookAhead[SLOTS_PER_EPOCH + (slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH)]
state_anomalies_found.potential_impact: If InitializeProposerLookahead returns a shorter array (due to error handling or state corruption), array access will panic
state_anomalies_found.mitigation: Add explicit length check: if len(lookAhead) < 2*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH then return error

state_anomalies_found.description: The test procedure mentions 'validator set changes occur at the fork boundary slot', but UpgradeToFulu is called with the pre-fork state at a specific slot. If validator activations/exits are processed in the same epoch transition that triggers the fork, the timing of InitializeProposerLookahead relative to epoch processing matters.
state_anomalies_found.abstract_state: epoch = slots.ToEpoch(beaconState.Slot()) computed from pre-fork state.Slot()
state_anomalies_found.timing_dependency: If fork occurs at slot S, and validator exits are processed at end of epoch(S-1), does beaconState passed to UpgradeToFulu reflect those exits?
state_anomalies_found.potential_impact: Race condition: If epoch processing (which updates validator exit_epoch, slashed flags) runs AFTER UpgradeToFulu, the lookahead is computed with stale validator set
state_anomalies_found.verification_required: Confirm UpgradeToFulu is called AFTER all epoch processing for the fork epoch completes

fork_transition_sequence: 1. Fork epoch begins at slot S (S = FULU_FORK_EPOCH * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH)
2. Epoch processing runs (process_epoch) - updates validator statuses
3. UpgradeToFulu(pre_fork_state) called with state at slot S
c. For slot in [0, SLOTS_PER_EPOCH): ComputeProposerIndex(pre_fork_state, activeIndices, seed[slot])
critical_dependencies: Pre-fork state must have correct validator set (no pending exits/slashings not yet applied)
RANDAO mixes in pre-fork state must be finalized (no further updates expected)
Active validator count must be non-zero for all epochs in lookahead range
Effective balances must be stable (no pending balance updates)

boundary_conditions.abstract_state: No validators satisfy activation_epoch <= epoch < exit_epoch
boundary_conditions.impact: InitializeProposerLookahead would fail, preventing fork transition
Proposer selection fails, preventing lookahead initialization
boundary_conditions.root_cause: State corruption or race condition in ActiveValidatorIndices

boundary_conditions.check: if epoch < stateEpoch || epoch > stateEpoch+1 { return error }
boundary_conditions.abstract_state: Requested slot's epoch is not current or next epoch
boundary_conditions.impact: Cannot use lookahead for historical slots; must fall back to seed-based computation
boundary_conditions.correctness: This is expected behavior, but edge case at epoch boundaries needs testing

boundary_conditions.abstract_state: lookAhead array must have exactly 64 elements for 2 epoch lookahead
boundary_conditions.verification: No runtime check in beaconProposerIndexAtSlotFulu; assumes correct size

recommendations.recommendation: Add explicit slashing filter to ActiveValidatorIndices or ComputeProposerIndex
recommendations.rationale: Prevent slashed validators from receiving proposer duties via lookahead
recommendations.suggested_fix: Change IsActiveValidatorUsingTrie to IsActiveNonSlashedValidatorUsingTrie (which already exists in codebase, line 54-58)

recommendations.recommendation: Document and test validator set change timing at fork boundary
recommendations.rationale: Ensure epoch processing completes BEFORE UpgradeToFulu is called
recommendations.test_case: Create test where validator exits at last slot of pre-fork epoch; verify they don't appear in epoch+1 lookahead

recommendations.rationale: Prevent panic from array index out of bounds if lookahead is corrupted

recommendations.recommendation: Add maximum iteration limit to ComputeProposerIndex
recommendations.rationale: Prevent unbounded loop in edge cases (all validators have 0 balance)
recommendations.suggested_fix: Add: if i > MAX_ITERATIONS { return error('no eligible proposer found') }

recommendations.recommendation: Verify RANDAO consistency assumption in specification
recommendations.rationale: Using pre-fork RANDAO for post-fork epochs must be intentional design choice
recommendations.documentation: Add comment explaining why pre-fork state's RANDAO is used for lookahead computation
